tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: gsang bdag yang gsang sgrub pa dang: nyi ma mdung gang ma bzhugs so:

shin tu zab bo : ྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ gsang bdag sgrub pa yang gsang ste: nang gi gter yin shin tu zab: skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas: 'khor 'das dngos 'dzin stong pa las: pad nyir hūm̐ las dran rdzogs su: rang nyid gsang bdag mthing nag khros: rdo rje phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub: sbrul nag 'dzin cing zhal du gsol: seng lpags stod g.yogs stag sham can: rin chen dbu rgyan sbrul gyis spras: zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs gza' klu brdzis: ye shes me yi klong na gsal: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ mtshan las: 'od 'phros ye shes spyan drangs thim: thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ sngags bskor: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ nī lam bhā ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ra dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā: sarba duṣ+ṭān hur thums mā ra ya phaṭa: ra la ra tsa rang nad rang la zhi zhi: sku dang sngags phreng hūm̐ yig las: khro bo mtshon cha me dpung 'phros: gdon bgegs lus gtubs nus stobs bcom: bsregs shing rdul brlags mi dmigs bsam: shin tu zab: nyi ma mdung gang dus nyid du: mdun du bris sku bsam par bya: de yang dkar po thal sbyar 'dud: sngags de tshar gsum brjod pa na: me long has btab bzhin du yal: dgu gsum sngags gnad shes pa na: gza' grib la ni mchog tu bsngags: nus ldan drag po'i dgongs gter yin: ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈ rgya shog la rgya snag gis bri: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ za yig gu gul byug: nyi ma mdung gang la za: ༁ྃ: rtsa gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i lha la 'dud: skyabs sems sngon du song nas: gnyis snang mi dmigs stong pa las: hūm̐ las me dpung rdo rje yi: ra gur srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang: hūm̐ las rang nyid dran rdzogs su: bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag po mthing: zhal gcig phyag gnyis khro gtum rngams: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan gsum dmar: smar smin dbu skra dmar ser 'bar: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga gdengs:

g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin: seng ge'i pags pas stod g.yogs dang: stag lpags smad dkris sbrul rigs lnga: thod skam cod pan thod rlon phreng: dur khrod chas 'chang zhabs gnyis kyis: 'dor stabs 'jigs byed dus mtshan mnan: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: ye shes me dpung dbus su gsal: gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan: ye nas dam ye dbyer med gyur: thugs kar hūm̐ la sngags phreng bskor: oṃ nī lam bhā ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi ra dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā: sham bur/ ra la ra tsa rang nad rang la zhi zhi: zhes bzla: tshes dgu gsum la nyi ma mdung gang dus ma chag pas gza' yi gnod pa mi 'byung: za yig 'di kho na 'o: mthar mi dmigs par bsam: shin tu zab bo: yid ches nyams su longs dang gsal: zhes rdo rje drag pos brjod pa'o// sarba maṅga laṃ/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: gsang ba'i bdag po'i dbang sku bzhi myur smin zhes bya ba bzhugs so: 1$0000300ྈྈ ྈྈྈ rtsa gsum 'du 'bral med pa'i lha la 'dud: gsang bdag gi dbang la: maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshom bu sngon po bkod: mañdzir bum pa rdzas nyer lnga chus bkang ba bsham: mi rus phreng ba: gnam lcags rdo rje: sku tsakli: gtor ma bsham: mchod pa sman raka bsham: dbang sgrub song nas: khrus maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro: lo rgyus brjod nas gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas gtso: skal ldan bdag cag rnams la ni: dpal chen gsang ba'i bdag po yi: dbang bskur dam pa bstsal du gsol: lan gsum: gur nas byung ba'i skyabs sems lan gsum: dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs 'chi: sogs/ khyad par gyi gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod: byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la: mchod cing ji ltar gsol ba ltar: bdag kyang skyob pa'i don gyi phyir: nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol: lan gsum gsol ba btab: lha bskyed ye shes pa bstim: tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par bya:

bum pas dbang bskur: bum pa chos dbyings gzhal yas su: bum rdzas badz+ra gtum po'i sku: thugs rje rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro: sku lnga ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī ye sogs: bzlas lung bsgrang phreng gtad: bdud dang kla klo log lta can: bsgral pa'i ni rag shu'i bgrang phreng: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: drag sngags nus mthu mngon gyur shog: rdo rje snying gar bzhag: gnam lcags rdo rje rab 'bar ba: hūm̐ yig mthing nag mtshan pa yis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: thugs mchog ye shes mngon gyur shog: sku spyi bor bzhag la: drag shul gtum chen sku 'di nyid: sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan rdzogs: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: khro rgyal yon tan mngon gyur shog: gtor ma spyi bor bzhag la: dpal gyi gtor ma chen po 'di: khro rgyal phrin las 'dus pa'i rdzas: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur ro: gang brtsam las bzhi thogs med shog: gtor ma de mthar rtsa sngags la: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta gu ṇa karma a bhi ṣiñtsa: btags: : dh+ya: dam tshig khas blang maṇ+ḍal phul: gsang bdag gi dbang chog sku bzhi myur smin zhes pa rdo rje drag pos rgyam rgyal rdo ti'i pho brang gangs dang nye ba nas bris/ sarba maṅga laṃ:/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: phyag na rdo rje dregs pa 'joms byed kyi sgo nas gza' yi gdon khrol nyung ngu rnam gsal bzhugs so: 1$0000300༁ྃ: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ gza' yi gdon bkrol ni: bcas rnams dpe'u ris ltar las tshang bar bsham: yi dam bdag bskyed dang phrin las gzhung bsrang: mdos rnams sngags drug phyag drug dang ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis brlabs la: yi dam gnas 'gyur te phyag rdor dregs 'joms su bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rang sems ngo bo pad+ma 'byung: gsang bdag dregs pa kun 'dul ni: sku mdog mthing nag srin po'i gzugs: khros pa'i zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs:

ljags 'dril hūm̐ phaṭa phem gyi sgras: khams gsum g.yo zhing srid gsum 'dar: smin ma sma ra ag tshom las: me lce 'bar zhing thog ser 'khrugs: dbu skra dmar ser srid rtser 'khyil: thod skam rigs lngas skra mtshams brgyan: phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu phyar: g.yon pas zhags pa lcags sdig 'dzin: glang ko zhing chen stag sham dang: sbrul chun mgo phreng ga sha 'chang: khrag thig zhag gi zo ris dang: thal chen byugs pas 'gugs byed brgyan: g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang zhabs 'og tu: dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad brdzis: pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i khri: ye shes me yi klong du gsal: ye nas dam ye dbyer med pa'i: thugs srog sa bon hūm̐ mthing nag: de la sngags kyis bskor bar bsam: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi gu ru kro dha hūm̐: ci nus bzla: de nas mdos gtor de shes pa gsum ldan las: dang por bskyed pa ni: mdos gtor mi dmigs stong par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid lhar: gsal ba'i mdun du dur khrod kyi: sa gzhi keng rus ri yi steng: khrag mtsho 'khyil zhing me rlung nang: rin chen las grub gzhal yas dbus: ra las gza' bdud sgra gcan 'dzin: mthing nag dbu dgu phyag bzhi pa: sku stod srin po sku smad sbrul: steng gi lha zhal gsum po bzhad: bar ma bdud kyi zhal gsum khro: 'og ma srin gyi zhal gsum gtum: mgo lus mig gis rab tu gang: stod zhal srid gsum srog la gtum: phyag bzhi dang gnyis chu srin gyi: rgyal mtshan sbrul gyi zhags pa dang: 'og gnyis ral gri mda' gzhu 'dzin: mi lpags gos gyon sbrul gyis brgyan: chu srin mgo dgu la 'chibs pa: 'khor du yak+sha dz+wa la dang: rdo rje glog 'gyu gza' brgyad dang: rgyu skar nyer brgyad snang srid pa'i: lha srin sde brgyad bskor ba 'o: hūm̐: 'bod do byon no gza' chen po: drang srong smug nag 'od zer 'phro: khyab 'jug rā hu mthu stobs ldan: 'jig rten phung byed mdos la byon:

yak+sha dz+wa la mdos la byon: rdo rje glog 'gyu mdos la byon: bi nā ya ka mdos la byon: sprul pa gza' brgyad mdos la byon: rgyu skar nyer brgyad mdos la byon: gdong mo mched bzhi mdos la byon: 'dir gshegs mdos dang gtor ma bzhes: de ring mdos glud bzhes phyir gshegs: snang srid 'byung po ma lus pa: de ring mdos glud bzhes phyir gshegs: gza' bdud chen po 'khor dang bcas: 'bod do mdos glud 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag gi smreng 'di gson: rgyu sbyor 'di yi nad 'di sol: nad pa gdon gsum gtor ma dang: sngags tshan gnyis po brjod: ting lo sbyang: pho gdon mo gdon klu gdon gsum: gdon rnams kun gyi dbang 'chor zhing: nad rnams kun gyi sna 'dren te: gtor ma lan chags mar me 'di: 'dod yon lnga ru byin brlabs nas: bsngo 'o tshim zhing dga' mgur rol: gnod dang khro ba'i sems spongs la: 'di ru ma 'dug rang gnas song: sum+bha ni sa brab: khrus byas: hūm̐: nga ni gsang bdag dregs 'dul te: sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun spros nas: rgyu sbyor yon bdag la phog pas: grib dang ma rig 'khrul pa'i nad: lus kyi dbang po'i sgo brgyad dang: ba spu'i khung nas phyir thon te: nad rnams rnag khrag mi gtsang tshul: gdon rnams 'bu srin srog chags gzugs: sdig sgrib dud khu sol khu'i tshul: rim dgu sa yi 'og tu song: sdig sgrib nad gdon kun dag nas: lus ni dwang pa'i shel ltar gyur: oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi gu ru kro dha hūm̐: gza' grib thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: gdong gi grib phog pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: mjug gi grib phog pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: sa gza'i grib phog pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: chu gza'i grib phog pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: me gza'i grib phog pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā:

rlung gza'i grib phog pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: nam mkha' stong nyid kyi gza'i grib phog pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: 'byung bzhi'i gza'i mdangs grib phog pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: gza' chen po mthong ba'i dug grib phog pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: gza' chen kha rlangs kyi dug gi grib phog pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: gza' chen po'i reg pa'i dug gi grib phog pa thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā: mi gtsang ba dang 'khrul pa'am reg pa'i dug thams cad zhi ba shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dug phyung dngos ni: hūm̐: sngon byung dug gi khungs bshad na: ma rig pa las dug lnga byung: sngon rabs 'das pa'i bskal pa la: zhe sdang las skyes me yi dug: 'dod chags las skyes chu yi dug: nga rgyal las skyes sa yi dug: phrag dog las skyes rlung gi dug: gti mug las skyes nam mkha'i dug: dug lnga gcig tu sprul pa las: gza' bdud chen po zhes su srid: 'gro drug sems can thams cad kyang: ma dag 'khrul pas byol nyog spyad: dug lnga de yis 'khor bar bcings: dag pa chen po'i klong du ni: ye shes lnga yi rol pa las: sa brgyad byang sems rā hu la: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dgongs pa rtogs: de ring nyon mongs dug lnga'i dug: ye shes lnga yi ngang du phyung: tsha zhing sreg pa me yi dug: rgyu sbyor 'di yi drod la phog: dug khyod ma 'dug phyir phyungs la: 'dra glud 'di yi phyi la song: rlan zhing gsher ba chu yi dug: rgyu sbyor 'di yi khrag la phog: dug khyod ma 'dug phyir phyungs la: 'dra glud 'di yi phyi la song: sra zhing 'thas pa sa yi dug: rgyu sbyor 'di yi sha la phog: dug khyod ma 'dug phyir phyungs la: 'dra glud 'di yi phyi la song: yang zhing g.yo ba rlung gi dug: rgyu sbyor 'di yi dbugs la phog: dug khyod ma 'dug phyir phyungs la:

'dra glud 'di yi phyi la song: stong shing dngos med nam mkha'i dug: rgyu sbyor 'di yi sems la phog: dug khyod ma 'dug phyir phyungs la: 'dra glud 'di yi phyi la song: 'byung ba lnga yi dug phog pa: ye shes lnga yi ngang du phyungs: dug khyod ma 'dug phyir phyungs la: 'dra glud 'di yi phyi la song: gza' bdud chen po'i dug phog pa: rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gyi mthus phyungs: dug khyod ma 'dug phyir phyungs la: 'dra glud 'di yi phyi la song: gdong gis sreg pa me yi dug: rgyu sbyor 'di la phog pa kun: dug khyod ma 'dug phyir phyungs la: 'dra glud 'di yi phyi la song: mjug ma g.yo byed dud pa'i mdog: rgyu sbyor 'di la phog pa kun: dug khyod ma 'dug phyir phyungs la: 'dra glud 'di yi phyi la song: yak+sha dz+wa la glog 'gyu ma: gza' chen brgyad kyi grib phog byung: dug khyod ma 'dug phyir phyungs la: 'dra glud 'di yi phyi la song: gdong mo bzhi dang rgyu skar gyis: mdangs dang 'od zer grib phog phyungs: dug khyod ma 'dug phyir phyungs la: 'dra glud 'di yi phyi la song: dkon mchog rtsa gsum bden pa dang: gsang ba'i bdag po'i byin rlabs stobs: gsang sngags lha sngags ting 'dzin mthus: dug rnams thams cad phyir phyungs song: dug rnams gnas 'dir ma 'dug cig: dug rnams ma lus phyir dengs shig: me yi nang dang chu yi nang: sa dang rlung dang nam mkha' ste: dug rnams so so'i gnas su song: hūm̐ badz+ra pā ṇi gu ru kro dha hūm̐: rā hu la ke ta ke ta yak+sha dz+wa la nā gi a ya ma du ru tsa sha na tri sarba nak+ṣa ki ma ra na sarba ha la raṃ baṃ laṃ yaṃ e shān+tiṃ ku ru hūm̐ dug thams cad phyungs shig: shes pa gsum ldan las: gnyis pa smreng dngos ni: hūm̐: gza' bdud rgyu skar gdon tshogs rnams: rnal 'byor bdag la snyan gson cig: rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po 'dis: kha yis ma len lag ma nyes:

ma bsad stong dang ma brkus 'jal: rang las lhag pa'i 'dra glud 'di: rgyu ni rin chen 'bru sna lnga: rkyen ni 'byung ba bzhi las grub: skye mched dod cing dbang po tshang: de ring glud 'di ci la gtong: yon bdag 'di yi tshab tu bsngo: na mi phod pa'i glud du bsngo: shi mi phod pa'i glud du bsngo: 'bul ba bdag gis mi nor te: bzhes pa khyod kyis ma 'khrul zhig: yon bdag 'di yi rkyen sol cig: hūm̐: rmad du byung ba'i gtor ma 'di: bcud ldan 'bru yi phye ma la: chang rgod phud kyis sbrus pa ste: mkhar thabs phyi snod gzhal yas khang: bshos bu nang bcud lha yi rdzas: mtshon byed dpe dang brda ru ston: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan bsung zhim dang: ro ldan reg bya 'jam pa ste: 'dod yon lnga yis rab tu brgyan: thugs kyi bzhed pa kun 'jo ba'i: mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod du ston: ngo bo zag pa med pa ste: ye shes bdud rtsir gyur pa 'di: gza' bdud rgyal po rā hu la: yab yum sprul pa gza' brgyad dang: rgyu skar lha dang gdong mo bzhi: sprul pa yang sprul bcas la 'bul: dgyes pa'i ngang nas mdos bzhes la: zhi ba'i ngang nas phrin las mdzod: gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje dang: rdo rje thod phreng bka' ma bcag: rnal 'byor bdag gi dam tshig dgongs: yon bdag yon 'bul chud ma gsan: mdos rdzas glud gtor 'di bzhes la: yon bdag bzung pa da thongs shig: bcings pa khrol la na ba sol: nad longs gdon song dug rnams song: 'chi ba'i dus la babs na yang: lo dgu'i bar du bshol thobs la: tshe srings dpal dang gzim dngas skyed: bsam pa'i don rnams mchis par shog:

gdon spo ba ni: smra shes 'gro mkhas rin chen las: legs grub 'dra glud ngar mi khyod: yon bdag 'di yi glud du song: gdon 'di ngar mi khyod la spo: nad 'di ngar mi khyod kyis longs: dug 'di ngar mi khyod kyis phyungs: grib 'di ngar mi khyod kyis khyer: rgyu sbyor 'di yi lus dang ngag: sems nyid sha rus lpags pa dang: dug gsum rkyen gyis bskyed pa yi: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang: grib dang gdon gyi rigs gyur kun: sku glud ngar mi khyod la spo: nad 'di ngar mi khyod kyis longs: gdon 'di ngar mi khyod kyis longs: khyod kyis nad 'di khur la song: lam bstan pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen gsang ba'i bdag po dang: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' bar: gza' bdud chen po 'khor bcas kyis: rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po la: sngon chad gnod pa byas pa sol: gza' yi nad dang gdon rnams kun: da lta nyid du zhi bar mdzod: rang dug rang gis da phyungs shig: rang mtshon rang gis da sdus shig: gdug pa'i spu mda' da thon cig: bsam sbyor ngan pa byas pa shigs: lag brgya ngan pas bcings pa khrol: mthong ba'i dug dang reg pa'i dug: kha rlangs dug rnams phyir phyungs shig: bsam ngan dug dang dri tshor dug: zer gyi dug rnams phyir phyungs la: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: smras pa'i tshig dang bshams pa'i rdzas: bden med 'chol bar ma gtang bar: phyin chad gnod pa ma byed cig: gal te gnod pa byas gyur na: phyag na rdo rje thugs khros nas: skad cig nyid la brlag par 'gyur: de bas dam la ma 'da' bar: mdos rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: gza' dang rgyu skar gnod rnams kun: so so rang rang gnas su gshegs: da ni gza' gshegs sha ra ra: skar gshegs de ni si li li: gza' gshegs de ni dgung du gshegs: skar gshegs de ni gnam du gshegs: nam mkha' stong pa gza' yi lam: bar snang stong pa skar ma'i lam:

gza' lam de ni gnam du bstan: skar gshegs de ni dgung du gshegs: dar lam mer mer dag la gshegs: 'ja' lam gya gyu dag la gshegs: mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings su gshegs: chos kyi dbyings su lam bstan no: chos kyi dbyings nas phyir ma ldog: oṃ rā hu la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha gats+tsha: zhes gza' yi gdon khrol nyung ngu rnam gsal 'di bzhin/ mi pham chos kyi nyi ma 'jam dpal ye shes rgya mtsho'i sde yis bkod pas 'gro kun gza'i nad gdon las grol nas/ gtan bde'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
